The '''Hidden Cave''' was located in the [[Nightsister lair]] and was the home of Old [[Daka]], who summoned the [[Army of the Dead]] to [[Battle of Dathomir|destroy]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army|Droid Army]] which had attacked [[Dathomir]]. Normally accessible only by [[magick]], the [[cave]] was breached during the battle when a [[BX-series droid commando|commando droid]] blasted it with a [[Missile launcher|rocket launcher]]. The destruction of the cave's entrance allowed [[General]] [[Grievous]] to [[Death|murder]] Daka and disrupt [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]]'s [[voodoo]] [[torture]] of [[Count]] [[Dooku]].<ref name="Massacre" />
